arxiv-2107-08523.title: Argument Linking a survey and forecast
arxiv-2107-08523.creator: William A. H. Gantt IV
arxiv-2107-08523.description: Abstract Semantic role labeling (SRL)—identifying the semantic relationships between a predicate and other constituents in the same sentence—is a well-studied task in natural language understanding (NLU). However, many of these relationships are evident only at the level of the document, as a role for a predicate in one sentence may often be filled by an argument in a different one.

arxiv-2112-15534.title: A phase transition for the probability of being a maximum among random vectors with general iid coordinates
arxiv-2112-15534.creator: Royi Jacobovic and Or Zuk
arxiv-2112-15534.description: Abstract Consider n n iid real-valued random vectors of size k k having iid coordinates with a general distribution function F F . A vector is a maximum if and only if there is no other vector in the sample that weakly dominates it in all coordinates.

Intensity interferometers do not rely on phase coherence of the optical elements and thus function without high grade optics and light combining delay lines. arxiv-2201-11560.title: Assessment of Detached Eddy Simulation and Sliding Mesh Interface in Predicting Tiltrotor Performance in Helicopter and Airplane Modes
arxiv-2201-11560.creator: Feilin Jia and John Moore, Qiqi Wang
arxiv-2201-11560.description: Abstract This paper presents numerical investigation on performance and flow field of the full-scale XV-15 tiltrotor in both helicopter mode (hovering flight and forward flight) and aeroplane propeller mode using Detached Eddy Simulation, in which the movement of the rotor is achieved using a Sliding Mesh Interface.

arxiv-2203-13960.title: A Relation of the Allen-Cahn equations and the Euler equations and applications of the equipartition
arxiv-2203-13960.creator: Dimitrios Gazoulis
arxiv-2203-13960.description: Abstract . We will prove that solutions of the Allen-Cahn equations that satisfy the equipartition of the energy can be transformed into solutions of the Euler equations with constant pressure. As a consequence, we obtain De Giorgi type results, that is, the level sets of entire solutions are hyperplanes.

arxiv-2308-00900.title: Metric and Path-Connectedness Properties of the Fréchet Distance for Paths and Graphs
arxiv-2308-00900.creator: Erin Chambers, Brittany Terese Fasy, Benjamin Holmgren, Sushovan Majhi, Carola Wenk
arxiv-2308-00900.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Erin Chambers, Brittany Terese Fasy, Benjamin Holmgren, Sushovan Majhi, Carola Wenk. The Fréchet distance is often used to measure distances between paths, with applications in areas ranging from map matching to GPS trajectory analysis to hand-writing recognition. More recently, the Fréchet distance has been generalized to a distance between two copies of the same graph embedded or immersed in a metric space; this more general setting opens up a wide range of more complex applications in graph analysis.

arxiv-2312-05502.title: Poisoning × \times Evasion: Symbiotic Adversarial Robustness for Graph Neural Networks
arxiv-2312-05502.creator: Ege Erdogan, Simon Geisler, Stephan Günnemann
arxiv-2312-05502.description: Abstract It is well-known that deep learning models are vulnerable w.r.t. small input perturbations. Such perturbed instances are called adversarial examples. Adversarial examples are commonly crafted to fool a model either at training time (poisoning) or test time (evasion). In this work, we study the symbiosis of poisoning and evasion.

arxiv-2411-13505.title: Capacity of loop-erased random walk
arxiv-2411-13505.creator: Maarten Markering
arxiv-2411-13505.description: Abstract We study the capacity of loop-erased random walk (LERW) on ℤ d \mathbb{Z}^{d} . For d ≥ 4 d\geq 4 , we prove a strong law of large numbers and give explicit expressions for the limit in terms of the non-intersection probabilities of a simple random walk and a two-sided LERW.

arxiv-2412-14712.title: On the localization regime of high-dimensional directed polymers in time-correlated random field
arxiv-2412-14712.creator: Jiaming Chen
arxiv-2412-14712.description: Abstract This paper describes directed polymer on general time-correlated random field. Law of large numbers, existence and smoothness of limiting free energies are proved at all temperature. We also display the delocalized-localized transition, via separating techniques for entanglement of the random field. Contents 1 Introduction Take N particles in a fluid and assume their interactions are connected by harmonic strings.

arxiv-2501-08734.title: Background reduction in 136 Xe double beta decay experiments through direct barium ion detection
arxiv-2501-08734.creator: A. Peralta Conde
arxiv-2501-08734.description: Abstract Tagging barium ions in double beta decay experiments involving 136 Xe offers a promising pathway to achieving an almost background-free environment, which is essential for addressing key unresolved questions in neutrino physics, such as the nature of neutrinos and their mass hierarchy.

arxiv-2508-21446.title: Contrarian Motives in Social Learning: Information Cascades with Nonconformist Preferences Thanks: We are grateful to Alexis Belianin, Emiliano Catonini, Darina Cheredina, Markus Gebauer, Olivier Gossner, Vitalijs Jascisens, Margarita Kirneva, Yukio Koriyama, Fabian Slonimczyk, and Alexey Verenikin
arxiv-2508-21446.creator: Georgy Lukyanov, Vasilii Ivanik
arxiv-2508-21446.description: Abstract We embed a taste for nonconformity into a canonical Bikhchandani–Hirshleifer–Welch social-learning model. Agents value both correctness and choosing the minority action (fixed or proportion-based bonus). We study exogenous signals and endogenous acquisition with a fixed entry cost and convex cost of precision in a Gaussian–quadratic specification.

arxiv-2509-21160.creator: Soham Bonnerjee, Sayar Karmakar, Subhrajyoty Roy
arxiv-2509-21160.description: Abstract With the increasing popularity of large language models, concerns over content authenticity have led to the development of myriad watermarking schemes. pmc-11686461.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Aerosol contamination presents significant challenges across various industries, ranging from healthcare to manufacturing. Over the past few years, open foam filters have gained prominence for their ability to efficiently capture particles while allowing reasonable airflow. In this work, we present the use of 3D-printed idealized open foam-like lattice structures as aerosol filtration media, leveraging advances in additive manufacturing to generate these highly tunable and modular filters.
